name: Shape wipe
what: A transition to put over a cut: bars, a circle, a slanted panel, two halves or thin stripes cover the frame in two colours, hold, then clear the other way - the cut goes where it is fully covered. Words can show while it covers.
origin: shape transitions - the template kinds marketplaces list (Mixkit, Envato Elements, Motion Array, Videohive), researched 2026-10-16
motion: covers 12 f (power3.inOut; bars / stripes staggered, each 70 % of it), the front layer 3 f behind the back one; holds 6 f; clears 12 f the other way, the front first
min_frames: start + 2 * cover_frames + hold_frames + 6 if reveal else start + cover_frames + 3
min_why: it starts clearing at start + 3 + cover + hold + 3 and skips the clear when that would end after the last frame (the frame stays covered); put the cut at start + cover + 6
